notes.title: May 8th Update
notes.content:
[h1]Full Update List[/h1]
[list]
[*] Now you can adjust brightness of the game.
[*] The game starts with the book ‘Start’. 
[*] We gave the title a cute BGM.
[*] In the chamber of the Crimson Sky, puzzles don’t get reset when you step out the room. 
[*] In the chamber of the Crimson Sky, the ring puzzle piece on the goddess don’t get twisted anymore.
[*] In the chamber of the Magic Pot wooden doll’s heart doesn’t bounce off too far.
[*] When objects get sucked into the great book, they don’t go through the users.
[*] You will get hints when you shoot letters.
[*] Samuel talks about more various topics.
[*] You can eat apples and carrots using magic.
[/list]

notes.title: April 24th Update
notes.content:
[h1]Full Update List [/h1]
[list]
[*] The hat icon in the prologue is replaced with a different one to prevent confusion.
[*] Fixed an issue in the prologue, where the reset spell doesn’t work properly after the pots are smashed.
[*] The magic hat gives more hints in Chamber of the Great Lotus.
[*] Fixed a case where starlamp puzzle could not be solved sometimes in Chamber of the Great Lotus.
[*] Fixed a case where a stone board wouldn’t appear in Chamber of Six Pillars.
[*] Fixed a case where the magic hat gives weird hints in Chamber of the Magic Pot.
[/list]
